source: National Archives Amendments 11–27 transcript, Amendment XXVII
review_notes: Codex reviewed the complete Twenty-seventh Amendment. The timing restriction applies to compensation laws for Senators and Representatives separately. The claims say only that an election must intervene before effect; they do not assert the law must then take effect. These are Codex labels, not independent human labels.
text:
AMENDMENT XXVII

No law, varying the compensation for the services of the Senators and Representatives, shall take effect, until an election of Representatives shall have intervened.
